verdict.rationale: The SDK exposes a full agent loop with built-in tools (file read/write/edit, shell commands, web search), custom tools, subagents, and MCP integrations, letting a developer delegate multi-step tasks to Claude the way Claude Code itself does, with quickstart examples like an agent that reads code, finds bugs, and fixes them autonomously. missing for 10: independent hands-on user reports validating the delegation experience itself (only harness/UX complaints exist, not capability failures), and more concrete end-user (non-developer) delegation examples.
